method_difference.heading: Not a like-for-like benchmark

quotes.quote: the incidence of the composite endpoint in the ticagrelor group was significantly lower than the incidence in the clopidogrel group [OR = 0.83, 95%CI (0.77, 0.90), P<0.00001]

method_difference.reading: Its OR 0.83 is a Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio; our result is a hazard ratio, so agreement is not like-for-like. And its five rows include PLATO twice (below), so its pooled estimate is not a benchmark until de-duplicated.
